_comment: Machine-readable capability spec for the EOCaptioner tool. Read by orchestrator/tools/registry.py. See ../README.md for what each field means.
description: Sends one correctly-templated instruction to the fine-tuned EOCaptioner model for a given satellite patch and returns its raw text answer. Only understands 4 template shapes: free-text captioning, yes/no binary questions, lettered MCQ, and point/ref-anchored bounding box requests. See SYSTEM_PROMPT.md for the exact phrasing rules.

patch_id.description: The satellite patch identifier (e.g. 'KOS-34TEN-000-041'). Must be one of the patch_id values given to you in this turn's context.

instruction.description: Instruction phrased in one of the 4 required template shapes documented in SYSTEM_PROMPT.md.

unsupported_band_selections_reason: The offline EOCaptioner bundle (server/serve.py OfflineEOCaptioner) always requires an optical (S2) tensor -- SAR is only ever additive alongside it, never a standalone input.
notes: Only 'single' context sets are supported by this tool today. bitemporal_pair and cross_modal_pair need change-detection / fusion models that are not built yet -- see the other subfolders in system_prompts/.
